methodologyNotes: Prices fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible. Where the official page returned 403/503, redirected to a demo-only page, or published no self-serve prices, reputable third-party comparison sources (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice) were used and noted in each vendor's provenance. Classy.org redirected permanently (301) to pro.gofundme.com/c/pricing — that page is treated as the canonical source and the vendor is listed under 'GoFundMe Pro (formerly Classy)'. Fundly.com returned 403; the only third-party figure available ($1,000/yr basic) appeared on SoftwareAdvice under the brand 'NonProfitEasy/Fundly' without fee detail, so Fundly is excluded to avoid fabrication. NeonCRM redirected to an overview page with no published prices; excluded. Network for Good redirected to a sales-demo page; excluded. All prices are in USD. annualDiscountPct is null where only one billing cadence is published or the discount amount is not stated.

vendors.name: Donorbox
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://donorbox.org/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Annual discount advertised but exact percentage not published on page. Corroborated by GetApp listing.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Platform fee 2.95%–3.95% per transaction on top of payment processor fees (Stripe 2.2% + $0.30 or PayPal 1.99% + $0.49). Includes unlimited donation forms, crowdfunding, peer-to-peer, event ticketing, basic reporting, Donorbox CRM. Up to 10 team members.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Platform fee 1.75%–2% per transaction. Includes advanced form customizations, tracking & analytics, receipt rebranding, Zapier & API access, crypto/stock donations, recurring donation upsell, Jay AI assistant. Up to 10 team members. Annual billing discount advertised but exact percentage not published.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Contact sales for pricing. Platform fee 1.6%–2% per transaction. Includes all Pro features plus 24/7 priority support, Enterprise Customer Success Manager, custom domains, guided onboarding, fundraising coach. Up to 30 team members.

vendors.name: Givebutter
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://givebutter.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Annual billing prices confirmed equal to 12 × monthly (no separate annual-only discount percentage stated on page). Corroborated by GetApp listing.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited users, contacts, email blasts, campaigns, donation forms, CRM, marketing tools, fundraising pages, events, auctions, payment processing. With tips enabled: 0% platform fee, processing covered by donor tip. With tips disabled: 3% platform fee + 2.9% + $0.30 card processing.

plans.name: Plus (up to 250 contacts)
plans.notes: Contact-tiered pricing; this tier covers up to 250 contacts. Adds automated workflows, advanced email editor, texting, custom reports, data visualizations, file uploads, QuickBooks Online integration, discounted direct mail. Annual billing at $348/yr (equivalent to $29/mo, no stated percentage discount).

plans.name: Plus (up to 1,000 contacts)
plans.notes: Same features as Plus (250 contacts) tier; scaled to 1,000 contacts. Annual billing at $948/yr.

plans.name: Plus (up to 2,500 contacts)
plans.notes: Same features as Plus tier; scaled to 2,500 contacts. Annual billing at $1,548/yr.

vendors.name: GoFundMe Pro (formerly Classy)
vendors.provenance: classy.org/pricing redirects (301) to pro.gofundme.com/c/pricing — fetched that URL 2026-06-14. No self-serve flat prices published. GetApp lists $299/mo starting price (usage-based) for the legacy Classy product; noted in plan notes. Official page confirms custom pricing for orgs over $1M revenue.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: For nonprofits with annual revenue under $1M. Zero subscription fee and no setup cost per official page. Additional costs may apply based on payment processing fees and optional add-ons (Giving Cart, Live Events, Salesforce integration). Includes unlimited campaigns, donation forms, recurring giving, marketing analytics, donor dashboard, fraud protection.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: For nonprofits with annual revenue over $1M. Price not published; contact sales. GetApp corroboration lists starting price at $299/mo (usage-based) for legacy Classy product tier.

vendors.name: GiveWP (Give)
vendors.provenance: givewp.com/pricing redirects (301) to liquidweb.com/software/give/#pricing — fetched that URL 2026-06-14. Annual-only billing; no monthly option published. WordPress plugin with no platform/donation fees.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Billed annually at $199/yr ($199 ÷ 12 = ~$16.58/mo equivalent). No donation platform fees. Includes unlimited donation forms, donor database, Stripe/Square/PayPal support, basic reporting, campaign tracking, PDF receipts.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually at $399/yr ($399 ÷ 12 = ~$33.25/mo equivalent). No donation platform fees. Adds recurring donations, donor portal, fee recovery, MailChimp/Constant Contact, advanced reporting, 15+ international payment gateways, Zapier, Salesforce.

plans.name: Elite
plans.notes: Billed annually at $599/yr ($599 ÷ 12 = ~$49.92/mo equivalent). No donation platform fees. Adds peer-to-peer fundraising, funds and designations, tributes, drag-and-drop custom fields, currency switcher, WooCommerce donation upsells.

vendors.name: Zeffy
vendors.provenance: Official homepage https://www.zeffy.com fetched 2026-06-14 (zeffy.com/pricing returned 404). Platform explicitly markets 100% free with no subscription tiers; entire product offered at $0. Corroborated by GetApp listing.

plans.name: Free (All Features)
plans.notes: Completely free — no subscription fees, no transaction fees, no platform fees, no processing fees. Revenue model is optional donor tips only; nonprofits retain 100% of all donations. Features include: donations, recurring gifts, ticketing, events, raffles, auctions, memberships, peer-to-peer, online store, Tap to Pay (in-person), CRM, email newsletters.

vendors.name: Bloomerang
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://bloomerang.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14 (bloomerang.co/pricing redirected 301). Bundle plans require contact-sales quote. Individual starting prices published. Corroborated by GetApp and SoftwareAdvice listings.

plans.name: Bloomerang CRM (starting)
plans.notes: Billed annually; $125/mo is the published starting price — scales with constituent count. Unlimited users. Includes donor management, predictive insights, marketing automation, analytics, data management, mobile app. Must be purchased with Fundraising module for full bundled pricing.

plans.name: Bloomerang Fundraising (starting)
plans.notes: Billed annually; $40/mo starting price. Must be purchased as part of bundle with Bloomerang CRM. Includes donation forms, event management, text fundraising, auctions, peer-to-peer, reporting.

plans.name: Bloomerang Volunteer (starting)
plans.notes: Billed annually; $119/mo starting price. Includes volunteer management, AI scheduling, communication tools, screening, data sync with CRM, mobile apps.

plans.name: The GIVING Platform (Standard Bundle)
plans.notes: Bundled plan including Fundraising, CRM, and Volunteer. Contact sales for pricing.

plans.name: The GIVING Platform (Pro Bundle)
plans.notes: Everything in Standard plus unlimited automated outreach and event tools. Contact sales for pricing.

vendors.name: Funraise
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.funraise.org/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Corroborated by GetApp listing.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: For organizations with annual revenue under $1M. Platform fee 5% on transactions. Processing fee 2.9% + $0.60 (Funraise Payments via Stripe). Includes donation forms/pages, recurring giving, fundraising websites, events & ticketing, donor CRM, company matching, automated receipts.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually at $99/mo. Platform fee 0%–4% depending on features. Processing fee 2.9% + $0.60 (Funraise Payments via Stripe). Adds peer-to-peer fundraising, auctions, wealth screening, advanced reports & dashboards, email & SMS messaging, text-to-give, subaccounts, implementation & migration services, dedicated success manager.
